body:
The investigator-approved single installed-adapter attempt was made and **failed before any provider/model/PCA/descriptor operation**. This is a PeptideMT qualification-harness error, not evidence of a HydrAMP numerical defect.

The qualifier mistakenly lowered both parent soft and hard RLIMIT_AS to 1 GiB. The worker inherited that hard ceiling and raised `ValueError: not allowed to raise maximum limit` when setting its planned 8 GiB. The API preserved an incomplete `worker_preflight` receipt, zero native rows and attribution `not-executed`. The original runner's clean process exit was not scientific success; inspection of the receipt caught the failure.

Original approved plan SHA-256:
`1d4679f27d06d95bd402b1f9239e8dc1fc5120a722da5057be526220985da665`.
Preserved failure record:
`devguide/evidence/hydramp_execution_adapter_failed_execution.json`,
SHA-256 `3151d15891a9f7adf56f9ee1f68f7c42687c44f0bcd154de72663107a73aa94f`.
One public API attempt; **zero checkpoint/PCA loads, neural forwards, descriptor bundles, Macrel calls or retries**. Its 1.12 s / 56.1 MiB sampled tree-RSS figures measure failed startup, not inference.

Correction: parent **soft 1 GiB / hard 8 GiB**, preserving the worker's inheritable hard ceiling while the parent's active allocation ceiling remains 1 GiB. The qualifier now exits nonzero for incomplete/failed cases. No consumer/provider package, model, numerical method or installed environment changed. Consumer wheel remains `18b1cb18b9662092203aad9c64d45bc0d61a862577297c13a664572dbdbc3e83`; provider dev3 remains `81761e0d48d92f0956e0afc28b3b4154f16032de53c666fd2cfbb53606102ed7`.

**Four model-free qualifier guards pass**, including actual tiny parent/grandchild resource-limit inheritance and failed-result exit status. Durable guard:
`devtools/tests/test_hydramp_execution_qualification.py::test_parent_soft_limit_preserves_inherited_worker_hard_ceiling`.
Fix receipt: `devguide/evidence/hydramp_execution_parent_limit_fix.json`, SHA-256 `eb0765bac3822a760b84fc72ab9db33d44af4204a999b235df24b319cf56daa6`.
Ruff, formatting, report indexes, whitespace, HTML with warnings fatal and six model-free doctests pass. Existing 55 installed controlled checks are reused, not presented as real-checkpoint qualification.

A corrected **new single-attempt proposal** is frozen at:
`local_data/hydramp-execution-adapter-vceg9u_2/live-plan-corrected.json`,
SHA-256 **`31317bd3023165300d9558134e73c584a3bdfa25e2c619a200cff11c65c33608`**.
All 345 pinned files and both runtime inventories pass model-free preflight. The original attempt/source/plan remain retained; the new directory has no approval or attempt marker.

The proposed case remains 16 proposals / seed 1001; one checkpoint/PCA load/inverse, one decoder/AMP/MIC forward each (three neural forwards), one descriptor bundle. CPU 0/1, one numerical thread, nice 10; worker 180 s / whole case 210 s; 4 GB RAM intent, stop at 2 GiB sampled aggregate tree RSS; worker address space 8 GiB, parent soft 1 GiB / hard 8 GiB; host available RAM floor 8 GiB, disk floor 1 GiB, output ceiling 128 MiB. **No GPU, network, Macrel, legacy calls or retries.**

Fresh investigator approval is pending because the original authorization permitted one public API attempt with no retries, and the corrected plan/executable digest changed. No new real execution is inferred from this correction. This does not establish broader scientific acceptance, biological superiority or release readiness. Current source of truth: `devguide/hydramp_execution_adapter.md`.
